response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a broad, technically capable senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and infrastructure work, but his resume shows no direct experience with growth engineering, experimentation platforms, feature flagging, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or statistical/rollout-risk analysis — the core focus of this Principal role. His career trajectory (Staff-level titles, no cross-team platform leadership) also doesn't clearly demonstrate the IC6/Principal scope of owning multi-team systemic initiatives.
strengths: Deep, versatile engineering background across many languages and system types (C, C++, C#, Java, TypeScript, DLang)
Demonstrated experience with high-throughput, low-latency production services (Dunnhumby handling millions of requests/sec)
Strong builder/founder mentality with open-source platform experience (GISCollective) showing initiative and architecture ownership
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth-metrics platform experience
No telemetry/statistical analysis or bias-detection/rollout-risk background required for this role
Titles cap at Staff/Senior rather than Principal, with no clear track record of leading multi-team, cross-org initiatives

key_factors.factor: No demonstrated Principal-level cross-team technical leadership
Strong general engineering breadth and scale experience
